keyPoints.en: Western powers introduced a modern economy with five features: capital, technology, labour, large-scale export production and land.
keyPoints.bm: Kuasa Barat memperkenalkan ekonomi moden dengan lima ciri: modal, teknologi, buruh, pengeluaran besar-besaran untuk eksport dan tanah.

keyPoints.en: Tin and rubber became the main exports; Sarawak also produced oil (Miri, from 1910) and Sabah tobacco and timber.
keyPoints.bm: Bijih timah dan getah menjadi eksport utama; Sarawak juga mengeluarkan petroleum (Miri, mulai 1910) dan Sabah tembakau serta kayu balak.

meaning.en: Money invested to start mines and estates.
meaning.bm: Wang yang dilaburkan untuk membuka lombong dan ladang.

meaning.en: Large floating machine for tin mining, first used in 1912.
meaning.bm: Mesin terapung yang besar untuk melombong bijih timah, mula digunakan pada 1912.
Mengeluarkan terutamanya untuk dijual ke luar negara.

points.en: European companies and Chinese businessmen invested in tin mines, rubber estates and commercial farming.
points.bm: Syarikat Eropah dan peniaga Cina melabur dalam lombong bijih timah, ladang getah dan pertanian komersial.

points.en: Mining: steam pumps, gravel pumps and dredges (1912).
points.bm: Perlombongan: pam wap, pam kelikir dan kapal korek (1912).

points.en: Farming: H.N. Ridley's better rubber-tapping method; rubber seedlings arrived from Kew Gardens (1877).
points.bm: Pertanian: kaedah menoreh getah yang lebih baik oleh H.N. Ridley; anak benih getah tiba dari Kew Gardens (1877).

points.en: Chinese labourers for the mines; Indian labourers for the estates; Javanese and others too.
points.bm: Buruh Cina untuk lombong; buruh India untuk ladang; buruh Jawa dan lain-lain juga.

points.en: Huge mines and estates produced tin and rubber for world markets.
points.bm: Lombong dan ladang yang besar mengeluarkan bijih timah dan getah untuk pasaran dunia.

points.en: Large areas of land were opened for estates and mines with land titles.
points.bm: Kawasan tanah yang luas dibuka untuk ladang dan lombong dengan hak milik tanah.

question.en: State TWO features of the modern economy introduced by Western powers.
question.bm: Nyatakan DUA ciri ekonomi moden yang diperkenalkan kuasa Barat.

answer.en: Any two: large capital; modern technology such as dredges; immigrant labour; large-scale production for export; large areas of land.
answer.bm: Mana-mana dua: modal yang besar; teknologi moden seperti kapal korek; buruh imigran; pengeluaran besar-besaran untuk eksport; tanah yang luas.

keyPoints.en: Western administrations made laws and set up agencies to support the economy.
keyPoints.bm: Pentadbiran Barat menggubal undang-undang dan menubuhkan agensi untuk menyokong ekonomi.

keyPoints.en: Land laws (e.g. land titles; Malay Reservations Enactment 1913) and labour laws (contract and kangani systems).
keyPoints.bm: Undang-undang tanah (cth. hak milik tanah; Enakmen Tanah Simpanan Melayu 1913) dan buruh (sistem kontrak dan kangani).

keyPoints.en: Government departments, agency houses, and banking and insurance were introduced.
keyPoints.bm: Jabatan kerajaan, syarikat perwakilan, serta sistem kewangan dan insurans diperkenalkan.

meaning.en: Chinese labourers had their passage paid and worked to repay the debt.
meaning.bm: Tambang buruh Cina dibayar terlebih dahulu dan mereka bekerja untuk melunaskan hutang.

meaning.en: A foreman (kangani) recruited Indian labourers from his own village.
meaning.bm: Seorang mandur (kangani) merekrut buruh India dari kampungnya sendiri.

meaning.en: British firm that managed estates and mines for investors, e.g. Guthrie and Boustead.
meaning.bm: Syarikat British yang menguruskan ladang dan lombong bagi pelabur, cth. Guthrie dan Boustead.

meaning.en: 1913 law protecting land that only Malays could own.
meaning.bm: Undang-undang 1913 yang melindungi tanah yang hanya boleh dimiliki orang Melayu.

points.en: Land: clear land titles for investors in the Malay states, Sarawak and Sabah; Malay reserve land protected (1913).
points.bm: Tanah: hak milik tanah yang jelas untuk pelabur di Negeri-negeri Melayu, Sarawak dan Sabah; tanah simpanan Melayu dilindungi (1913).

points.en: Labour: contract system (Chinese) and kangani system (Indians).
points.bm: Buruh: sistem kontrak (Cina) dan sistem kangani (India).

points.en: e.g. Mines, Agriculture, Public Works and Railways departments; the Rubber Research Institute (1925).
points.bm: cth. Jabatan Galian, Pertanian, Kerja Raya dan Kereta Api; Institut Penyelidikan Getah (1925).

points.en: Agency houses managed estates; banks lent money; insurance protected businesses.
points.bm: Syarikat perwakilan menguruskan ladang; bank memberi pinjaman; insurans melindungi perniagaan.

question.en: Why was the Malay Reservations Enactment (1913) introduced?
question.bm: Mengapakah Enakmen Tanah Simpanan Melayu (1913) diperkenalkan?

answer.en: To stop Malay land from being sold to non-Malays and foreign investors, so that Malays kept their land.
answer.bm: Untuk menghalang tanah orang Melayu dijual kepada bukan Melayu dan pelabur asing, supaya orang Melayu mengekalkan tanah mereka.

keyPoints.en: To move tin and rubber, the British built transport and communication networks.
keyPoints.bm: Untuk mengangkut bijih timah dan getah, British membina rangkaian pengangkutan dan perhubungan.

keyPoints.en: Railways: the first line ran from Taiping to Port Weld (1885); Sabah's railway began in the 1890s.
keyPoints.bm: Kereta api: landasan pertama dari Taiping ke Port Weld (1885); kereta api Sabah bermula pada 1890-an.

keyPoints.en: Roads, ports (e.g. Port Swettenham, 1901), shipping, air services and telecommunications followed.
keyPoints.bm: Jalan raya, pelabuhan (cth. Port Swettenham, 1901), perkapalan, perkhidmatan udara dan telekomunikasi menyusul.

meaning.en: Port opened in Selangor in 1901 — today's Port Klang.
meaning.bm: Pelabuhan yang dibuka di Selangor pada 1901 — kini Pelabuhan Klang.

meaning.en: West-coast tin and rubber areas developed faster than the east coast and interior.
meaning.bm: Kawasan bijih timah dan getah di pantai barat membangun lebih pesat berbanding pantai timur dan pedalaman.

points.en: Railways linked mines and estates to ports: Taiping–Port Weld (1885), Kuala Lumpur–Klang (1886); in Sabah, Weston–Beaufort (1890s).
points.bm: Kereta api menghubungkan lombong dan ladang dengan pelabuhan: Taiping–Port Weld (1885), Kuala Lumpur–Klang (1886); di Sabah, Weston–Beaufort (1890-an).

points.en: Roads joined towns in the Malay states; Sarawak relied more on rivers.
points.bm: Jalan raya menghubungkan bandar di Negeri-negeri Melayu; Sarawak lebih bergantung pada sungai.

points.en: Ports such as Port Swettenham, Port Weld, Port Dickson, Kuching and Sandakan handled exports.
points.bm: Pelabuhan seperti Port Swettenham, Port Weld, Port Dickson, Kuching dan Sandakan mengendalikan eksport.

points.en: Steamship lines and, later, air services connected the region.
points.bm: Syarikat kapal wap dan kemudian perkhidmatan udara menghubungkan rantau ini.

points.en: Telegraph and telephone lines sped up business and government.
points.bm: Talian telegraf dan telefon mempercepat urusan perniagaan dan kerajaan.

question.en: Why did the east coast develop more slowly?
question.bm: Mengapakah pantai timur membangun lebih perlahan?

answer.en: Investment and transport followed tin and rubber, which were mostly on the west coast.
answer.bm: Pelaburan dan pengangkutan mengikut bijih timah dan getah, yang kebanyakannya di pantai barat.

keyPoints.en: Economic growth changed society: towns grew, a multi-ethnic society formed, and education, health services and prisons were introduced.
keyPoints.bm: Pertumbuhan ekonomi mengubah masyarakat: bandar berkembang, masyarakat berbilang kaum terbentuk, serta pendidikan, perkhidmatan kesihatan dan penjara diperkenalkan.

keyPoints.en: Immigrants worked in different sectors, so communities often lived apart — a plural society.
keyPoints.bm: Imigran bekerja dalam sektor berbeza, maka masyarakat sering tinggal berasingan — masyarakat majmuk.

meaning.en: Several ethnic groups living in one country, each with its own culture.
meaning.bm: Beberapa kumpulan etnik yang tinggal dalam satu negara, masing-masing dengan budaya sendiri.

meaning.en: Malay, Chinese and Tamil schools teaching in the mother tongue.
meaning.bm: Sekolah Melayu, Cina dan Tamil yang mengajar dalam bahasa ibunda.

meaning.en: Institute for Medical Research (1900, Kuala Lumpur), which studied tropical diseases.
meaning.bm: Institut Penyelidikan Perubatan (1900, Kuala Lumpur), yang mengkaji penyakit tropika.

points.en: Mining and trade towns: Kuala Lumpur, Ipoh, Taiping, Seremban; Kuching, Sibu, Miri; Sandakan, Jesselton.
points.bm: Bandar perlombongan dan perdagangan: Kuala Lumpur, Ipoh, Taiping, Seremban; Kuching, Sibu, Miri; Sandakan, Jesselton.

points.en: Malays mostly in villages and farming; Chinese in mines, trade and towns; Indians on estates and railways.
points.bm: Orang Melayu kebanyakannya di kampung dan bertani; orang Cina di lombong, perniagaan dan bandar; orang India di ladang dan kereta api.

points.en: Vernacular schools (Malay, Chinese, Tamil), English schools (e.g. Penang Free School, 1816), mission schools in Sarawak and Sabah.
points.bm: Sekolah vernakular (Melayu, Cina, Tamil), sekolah Inggeris (cth. Penang Free School, 1816), sekolah mubaligh di Sarawak dan Sabah.

points.en: Malay College Kuala Kangsar (1905) for Malay elites; SITC (1922) for Malay teachers.
points.bm: Kolej Melayu Kuala Kangsar (1905) untuk golongan elit Melayu; MPSI (1922) untuk guru Melayu.

points.en: Hospitals and the IMR (1900) fought diseases such as malaria and beriberi.
points.bm: Hospital dan IMR (1900) menangani penyakit seperti malaria dan beri-beri.

points.en: Prisons were built to enforce Western law (e.g. Pudu Prison, Kuala Lumpur).
points.bm: Penjara dibina untuk menguatkuasakan undang-undang Barat (cth. Penjara Pudu, Kuala Lumpur).

question.en: How did colonial economic policy shape our plural society?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah dasar ekonomi penjajah membentuk masyarakat majmuk kita?

answer.en: Immigrants were brought in for specific jobs in different places, so each community worked and lived mostly separately, with its own schools.
answer.bm: Imigran dibawa masuk untuk pekerjaan tertentu di tempat berbeza, maka setiap kaum kebanyakannya bekerja dan tinggal berasingan, dengan sekolah masing-masing.
